title: 634HD model overrides
description: 634HD behaviour for particular models, objects, face colours or areas: a material for untextured faces, wind sway, whether they cast shadows.

uv.description: how material is mapped on faces the game leaves untextured: box mapping in world space (default; neighbouring objects line up) or in the model's own space

replace.description: the material replaces the game's own textures too (default: only faces the game leaves untextured)

uvScale.description: tiles per repeat of the material (default 1)
